summary: Creature-go Mardu aikido that forces bad attacks, recycles visible traps with Extus, and routes borrowed damage through increasingly unsafe contraptions.

tags.name: aikido
tags.reason: The primary plan makes opposing creatures and damage punish their controllers.

tags.name: creatures
tags.reason: Thirty-three creatures form the visible defense, forced-combat package, and damage-reflection engine.

tags.name: forced combat
tags.reason: Imps, goad creatures, Angel's Trumpet, and Rite of the Raging Storm keep combat moving.

tags.name: self-damage
tags.reason: Reflectors, Volcano Hellion, Crypt Rats, and Coalhauler Swine deliberately manufacture dangerous damage events.

tags.name: combo
tags.reason: Tutorless packages include Stuffy Doll with Guilty Conscience and damage sweepers with Repercussion.

tags.name: graveyard
tags.reason: Extus repeatedly returns sacrificed, discarded, or destroyed nonlegendary creatures to hand.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Advocates, Crown of Doom, Humble Defector, and attack incentives create visible table bargains.

tags.name: sacrifice
tags.reason: Creature sacrifices pay for prevention, cards, mana, theft, and a damage sweep while Extus retrieves the body.

tags.name: burn
tags.reason: Damage finishes players, but most of it originates from their attackers or from creatures hurting themselves.

tags.name: group slug
tags.reason: Coalhauler Swine, Crypt Rats, Repercussion, and Angel's Trumpet can damage several players.

tags.name: spellslinger
tags.reason: Twenty instants and sorceries trigger Extus, but creatures remain the main shell.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Rite of the Raging Storm, Life of the Party, Goblin Spymaster, Inkshield, and Kher Keep make bodies.

tags.name: lifegain
tags.reason: Worthy Cause, Children of Korlis, and Soul Link offset damage the deck intentionally risks.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Ritual of the Machine is a single permanent theft effect.
